title: Warm Crisp Ukrainian Bacon Dumplings
description: A crowd-pleasing Ukrainian dish featuring crispy bacon and soft dumplings, wrapped in corn husks for a unique presentation, this low-sodium friendly recipe is perfect for any occasion. It is a resinous and flavorful dish that is sure to please
instructions: Start by preparing the namul according to package instructions, then set it aside to cool.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, egg, salt, and pepper, and mix until a dough forms.
Gradually add in the warm water, and continue mixing until the dough is smooth and elastic.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes, until it becomes pliable and easy to work with.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces, and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape, and place a slice of bacon in the center of each disk.
Add a spoonful of the cooled namul on top of the bacon, and fold the dough over to form a half-moon shape.
Wrap each dumpling in a corn husk, and secure with a strip of corn husk or kitchen twine.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat, and add a small amount of oil to the pan.
When the oil is hot, add the dumplings to the pan, and cook until they are crispy and golden brown on the bottom.
Serve the dumplings warm, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
